summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares International Equity Factor Rotation Active ETF (IDYN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed to tactically invest in large- and mid-cap global ex-US stocks based on style factors believed to outperform on a forward-looking basis. The fund may invest up to 35% in emerging market equities IDYN was launched on Aug 5, 2025 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: IDYN is an equity ETF with a total of 219 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 4.32%, Novartis AG at 2.83%, AstraZeneca at 2.29%, Iberdrola at 1.92%, and Banco Santander at 1.84%.
